messages.ui.rules.body:
Goal: explore the five-floor main run together and defeat each exit BOSS. The run fails when the whole party is down or dead. Content and tuning are still in development.

WASD moves, LMB attacks, RMB uses the current weapon skill, Space dodges, 1–4 uses consumables, and F interacts. F2 switches to mouse movement: hold RMB to move, tap it to pathfind, and use MMB for weapon skills. Only some weapons have a skill; each has a cooldown and may cost special resource. Bindings are configurable.

Hold Q/E or drag the camera button to rotate. Use the wheel to zoom scenes and maps. WASD follows screen directions. M or the minimap opens the large map: drag with LMB to pan, click a destination to confirm travel. Windows do not pause the game.

Personal travel follows the shortest complete route, costing 1 personal AP per connection, including returns and repeated visits. Shops and passages normally do not block transit. Unfinished battles and special events normally block transit until completed. Crossing intermediate nodes grants no rewards. Shops allow personal entry. Rooms are independent; completion leaves you in place. Open the map to continue. You cannot leave during waiting, combat, or wave breaks. Ordinary battles accept other players before combat and between waves.

Shared travel is adjacent only: propose from a node's right-click menu. Approval spends 1 shared AP for adjacent players who opted in; approval-only voters stay put. Shared-cost special nodes require a vote, and normal BOSS entry still gathers the team. Layer exits use physical devices; leaving their range withdraws the vote.

At zero shared AP, personal exploration and rescue remain possible; progression requires the enhanced BOSS. Spending the last shared AP on a normal BOSS does not enhance it. The enhanced BOSS curse subtracts 1 from both initial AP pools on later floors, does not stack, and lasts until cleansed.

Zero HP downs a player. Teammates can rescue after clearing the room. Each normal-mode penalty layer linearly removes 25% maximum HP and final damage. The fourth down causes death. Revival sets the current counter to 1; the third subsequent down causes death again.

Every level automatically adds 1 to all six attributes, plus the chassis growth preference. There is no manual allocation. The bottom-right inventory/status button shows weapon, coins, level and XP. Its attribute button opens an independent details window.

There are 27 bag slots, 9 separate equipment slots and normally 12 accessory slots. LMB picks up/places items; Shift+LMB quickly equips or unequips. Empty-handed RMB opens the details menu; while holding an item, RMB places one. Equipment never stacks; consumables normally stack to 30. The bag never sorts automatically and returns held items on close. Equipment can change in combat; weapon skill cooldown stays with its item instance. Shop operations and pickups require proximity.

Click a teammate to trade at any distance or combat state. Both must confirm the same offer; currency cannot be traded directly. Hover for summaries and hold Shift for calculations. Tooltips follow the pointer; ordinary windows can be dragged, opened together and closed independently.

A successful run archives carried items and awards meta points for learning at the personal base. Warehouse equipment cannot return to the main run. Special-mode and gameplay-mod progression do not feed normal progression.

Weapon descriptions show normal-hit damage with your current build, or an equip preview for unequipped weapons. Each damage segment has a complete player-side formula for normal and critical hits in the independent details window. Attribute scores and weights use their attribute colors; damage terms use their damage-type colors. Hover an operand to inspect its sources; click it to pin the calculation, then click sources to expand further. Long formulas scroll sideways.

messages.content.base:route-fold-2.name: Short Route Fold
messages.content.base:route-fold-2.description: Move up to 2 hexes along a straight hex line. Costs 1 personal AP.
messages.content.base:ring-ticket.name: Neighbourhood Ticket
messages.content.base:ring-ticket.description: Move to any node within 1 ring. Costs 1 personal AP.
messages.content.base:ring-pass.name: Neighbourhood Pass
messages.content.base:ring-pass.description: Move to any node within 1 ring. Costs 1 personal AP per use.
messages.content.base:route-fold-3.name: Long Route Fold
messages.content.base:route-fold-3.description: Move up to 3 hexes along a straight hex line. Costs 1 personal AP per use.
messages.content.base:coordinate-pass.name: Coordinate Pass
messages.content.base:coordinate-pass.description: Move to any node. Costs 1 personal AP per use.
messages.content.base:free-coordinate-ticket.name: Prepaid Coordinate Ticket
messages.content.base:free-coordinate-ticket.desc: Move to any node without spending personal AP.
messages.content.base:team-coordinate-ticket.name: Team Coordinate Ticket
messages.content.base:team-coordinate-ticket.desc: After a team vote, move all out-of-combat teammates, including downed players, to any node. Costs 1 shared AP.
messages.content.base:emergency-fuse.name: Emergency Fuse
messages.content.base:emergency-fuse.description: Negate a lethal hit and gain a shield equal to 50% of maximum health for 10 seconds.
messages.content.base:arrival-envelope.name: Arrival Envelope
messages.content.base:arrival-envelope.descriptio: After travelling with a movement item, gain a random accessory from the current floor pool.
messages.content.base:entry-kit.name: Entry Kit
messages.content.base:entry-kit.description: After travelling with a movement item to a combat node, gain +20% attack speed until leaving the room and a random floor accessory.
messages.content.base:entry-metronome.name: Entry Metronome
messages.content.base:entry-metronome.description: After travelling with a movement item to a combat node, gain +15% attack speed until leaving the room. Unlimited durability.
messages.content.base:fuse-shield.name: Emergency Shield
messages.content.base:fuse-shield.description: Absorbs damage equal to 50% of maximum health at application.
messages.content.base:arrival-haste-20.name: Arrival Tempo 20
messages.content.base:arrival-haste-20.descriptio: Attack speed +20% until leaving the room.
messages.content.base:arrival-haste-15.name: Arrival Tempo 15
messages.content.base:arrival-haste-15.descriptio: Attack speed +15% until leaving the room.

messages.ui.movement.boss_cost: BOSS assembly costs 1 shared AP; personal movement item costs apply separately.
